entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and Planeswalker who serves as the Living Guildpact of Ravnica; he reunites with Liliana and is recruited by Gideon to help on Zendikar.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer Planeswalker and Jace's former lover who is bound by demonic contracts and carries the Chain Veil; she comes to Jace seeking a fresh start.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Planeswalker and Boros ally who seeks Jace's help to solve the puzzle of leylines on Zendikar.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Jace's bailiff, who stands guard in ceremonial armor and knows Jace's secrets.

entities.name: Valko
entities.description: The ratlike maitre d' of Milena's restaurant.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A Planeswalker who is turning into a monster after fighting Liliana over the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon Planeswalker who had Liliana seek out Jace.

entities.name: Lazlo Lipko
entities.description: A Ravnican criminal whom Liliana killed after using his corpse as a spy.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The head of the Consortium Jace once belonged to.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where Jace is the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane ravaged by the Eldrazi that Jace inadvertently helped release.

entities.name: The Chain Veil
entities.description: A very powerful, ancient, cursed artifact that turns users into vessels for a long-dead race and demons.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monsters released on Zendikar that Gideon describes.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: Where Jace holds appointments as the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Milena's
entities.description: One of the finest restaurants in the Second District where Jace and Liliana dine.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A settlement on Zendikar that has fallen to the Eldrazi.

entities.name: The Golgari
entities.description: The guild whose ambassadors and zombie attendants meet Jace.

entities.name: The Azorius
entities.description: The guild of law whose legislation Jace reads.

entities.name: The Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild whose insignia Gideon flashes.

events.summary: Jace finishes a day of tedious petitions as the Living Guildpact and returns to his secret apartments.
events.quote: "Guildpact," said Lavinia. He turned. "Get some rest."

events.summary: Jace is surprised to see Liliana knocking at his secret door via the teleportal, and uses an illusion to greet her.
events.quote: Jace hadn't seen Liliana Vess since the day he'd realized she was playing him

events.summary: Liliana enters, and Jace refuses to trust her after she betrayed him; she reveals she had a spy killed to find him.
events.quote: "Nothing you can say will make me trust you," he said. "Not after you betrayed me."

events.summary: Liliana explains she is killing her demonic creditors, with two down, and describes the Chain Veil and how Garruk is becoming a monster.
events.quote: "Two down," she said, holding up two fingers and grinning. "Two to go."

events.summary: Liliana admits she hoped they could start over, and Jace plays along, agreeing to dinner.
events.quote: I guess I was hoping we could … start over.

events.summary: Jace and Liliana dine at Milena's, where she shows him the Chain Veil and he cannot take it.
events.quote: you can't take it, even if I wanted you to.

events.summary: Gideon, bloodied from battle, interrupts dinner and asks Jace for help with Zendikar.
events.quote: "Jace Beleren," he said. "I need your help."

events.summary: Gideon tells Jace Sea Gate has fallen and asks him to solve the puzzle of leylines.
Jace admits to himself he inadvertently released the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Inadvertently released them from millennia of imprisonment to terrorize Zendikar

events.summary: Liliana storms out when Jace agrees to go with Gideon, refusing his invitation to come along.
events.quote: "You're out of your mind," she said. "I've got demons to kill."

events.summary: Jace agrees to help Gideon, insisting he rest first, and takes him to a healer.
events.quote: "Fine," Gideon said at last. "Take me to this healer."

relations.note: Liliana was the first real lover he had; they are estranged.
relations.quote: She was also the first real lover he'd ever had

relations.note: He attacked her; she won and passed on the Veil's curse.
relations.quote: "He attacked me," she said. "I won. I guess he's carrying a grudge."
who'd sought him out on the orders of the dragon Planeswalker, Nicol Bolas

relations.note: Agrees to help Gideon on Zendikar.
relations.quote: "Of course," said Jace. "Tell me everything you know."
